Colorism is a form of discrimination based on skin color. It is the bias or preference toward lighter skin tones and can lead to unequal treatment of people with darker skin. Colorism can be intentional or unintentional, and it can affect all skin tones. It is a social, cultural, and historical phenomenon that has persisted for centuries.
